purpose: Render evidence in a short teacher-readable format while preserving source type and locator precision.

CN_curriculum.zh: 教育部《义务教育数学课程标准（2022年版）》 · {stage} · {section}

display_rules: Show source type before source details when curriculum, guidance and research appear together.
Use the shortest locator that uniquely supports the visible claim.
Do not display a page number that has not been directly verified.
If China exact textbook sequencing is pending, show the national-standard locator and a separate 现行教材顺序待核实 label.
If Common Core has no Grade 1-6 requirement for the concept, display No explicit Common Core Grade 1-6 standard rather than an empty citation.
Do not cite an umbrella source when a specific practice guide or guidance page directly supports the claim.
The Evidence section should normally show 2-4 sources, not every source attached to the concept.

not_explicit.en: No explicit requirement in this framework
not_explicit.zh: 该课程框架未明确设置此要求
